label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever PUBLIC_URL is not set in the environment, so password reset (and other) email links point at localhost in production. This likely means PUBLIC_URL isn't configured for the deployed environment since last week's release, or the fallback shouldn't silently default to localhost. The fix belongs here where BASE_URL is defined and used to build the reset-password link.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is what's being used to build the password reset link (and the rollup/report links). In production, PUBLIC_URL is apparently unset, so users get a localhost URL that doesn't load for them.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is set in the production environment/deploy config, and/or make the fallback fail loudly (e.g. throw or log an error) when running outside local development instead of silently defaulting to localhost, so this kind of misconfiguration is caught immediately rather than shipping broken links to users.
